stage: Raw contextual retrieval diagnostic only; not native Ken end-to-end
purpose: Measure whether broader-language embeddings complement CodeRank even if a standalone replacement loses quality
inputs: Closed top100 canonical eligible-symbol cosine lists for each original200query, from all original source owners
algorithm: Equal rank fusion: sum 1/(60+one_based_rank) over each model top100; zero contribution beyond each captured100; ties prefer best rank then canonical path/entity identity; return10
weights: Fixed equal weights; no fitting or query/repository conditional selection
metrics: Same original strict top1/top10; gains/losses against raw CodeRank; report separately from actual public API results
oracle: If showing union coverage of separate top10 lists, label it oracle coverage upper bound, never as a ten-slot retrieval result
quality_gate: Wait V320 and V321 all600APIcalls and raw captures closed; original references unchanged; reserve CLOSED
